comparison_to_1009.state: Price DOWN + CVD DOWN + OI DOWN

reference_levels_visible.note: Reference-chart levels only; execution venue basis must be recalculated before orders.

interpretation: The 79k squeeze payout reversed into a large long flush. Price, CVD and OI all fell while long liquidations dominated, indicating deleveraging/forced long closure rather than confirmed fresh bearish leverage expansion. This creates a better long location than chasing the squeeze high, but it is not an automatic market-buy signal because CVD also weakened and buyers have not yet re-established control.

management.for_existing_case_002_long: Treat as a potential add/reload setup, not a new numbered case.
management.aggressive_add_zone: Reference 77.20-77.35k around dOpen/dPOC, only after hold/reclaim or a successful retest with CVD stabilizing and OI no longer accelerating downward.
management.safer_confirmation: Reclaim/acceptance above roughly 77.65-77.75k after the flush, then stronger confirmation above dVAH near 78.22k.
management.invalidation: Acceptance below dOpen 77.215k weakens the setup; loss of dVAL ~76.68k is stronger invalidation. Price DOWN + CVD DOWN + OI UP would flip the regime back toward bearish leverage expansion.
management.do_not: Do not chase with a full-size market long immediately after the liquidation candle.

lesson: After a squeeze, Price DOWN + CVD DOWN + OI DOWN with dominant long liquidations is deleveraging. It can create a better reload zone, but the edge is in post-flush stabilization/reclaim, not in blindly catching the liquidation candle.
